case_number: Civil Appeal No.  of 2023 (Arising out of SLP (Civil) No.  /2023)

parties.respondent: The Tamil Nadu State Level Scrutiny Committee & Ors.

summary: Denial of post-retirement benefits after 38 years of service; caste certificate scrutiny delayed for 19 years; no pending enquiry at time of cessation order; right to pension as constitutional right under Article 300-A; harassment due to procedural delay; guidelines from Madhuri Patil case on expeditious verification; failure to follow due process; High Court's dismissal overturned.
legal_provisions_cited: Madhuri Patil v. Additional Commissioner, Tribal Development & Ors., (1994) 6 SCC 241
State of Jharkhand v. Jitendra Kumar Srivastava, (2013) 12 SCC 210
Dr. Uma Agarwal v. State of U.P., (1999) 3 SCC 438
State of W.B. v. Haresh C. Banerjee, (2006) 7 SCC 651
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; impugned judgments of the Madras High Court set aside; directions issued for expeditious re-determination of caste status and restoration of pensionary benefits pending such inquiry.
